title: Code examples can satisfy required headings
description: Fence detection only toggles on lines beginning with three backticks. Headings inside tilde fences are counted, and triple backticks incorrectly close four-backtick fences. Both cases were reproduced: `## Value` inside a code example satisfies the required section despite no actual section existing. Track fence character and opening length, and add regression tests.

title: Code examples can satisfy required headings
description: Fence detection only toggles on backtick prefixes, ignoring tilde fences and delimiter length. Verified that `## Value` inside a tilde-fenced block—or inside four backticks containing a three-backtick line—satisfies the required section. Track fence character and opening length, and add regression tests so example content cannot produce a false PASS.

title: Valid YAML comments cause docType rejection
description: The reused parser preserves inline comments: verified that `docType: slice-design # document kind` becomes the literal value `slice-design # document kind`. Consequently, this valid declaration fails the equality check. Parse YAML scalar comments correctly, preserving quoted content, and add coverage alongside the quoted-docType test.

title: Code examples can satisfy required sections
description: Fence detection recognizes only backticks at column zero. Verified that `~~~markdown\n## Value\n~~~` satisfies the required `## Value` section despite containing only example code. Track fence character, length, and allowed indentation; add regression tests for alternate fences.

title: Valid frontmatter comments cause docType rejection
description: The reused parser retains inline YAML comments: `docType: slice-design # design document` becomes the literal value `slice-design # design document`, causing rejection of a valid declaration. Parse comments correctly without stripping hashes inside quoted strings, and cover both cases in tests.

title: Fence detection can produce false passes and failures
description: Only column-zero backtick prefixes toggle fence state. Reproduced: headings inside tilde fences or indented backtick fences satisfy required sections; a shorter backtick sequence inside a longer fence causes subsequent real headings to be ignored. Track fence character, indentation and opening length, and add regression tests.

title: Valid YAML comments cause docType rejection
description: The reused parser retains inline comments, so `docType: slice-design # phase 4` fails the equality check despite declaring the correct YAML value. Handle commented values semantically and test both quoted and unquoted forms.

title: Code-block headings can satisfy required sections
description: The fence toggle recognizes only unindented triple-backtick prefixes and does not track fence length. Probes using tilde fences, indented fences, and four-backtick fences containing triple backticks all incorrectly returned `## Value` as a document heading. Consequently, code examples can satisfy missing sections. Track fence character and length, support valid indentation, and add regression tests.

title: Unregistered worktrees silently use the primary checkout’s template
description: `resolveProjectWorktree` discovers an unregistered Git worktree’s parent project but returns no `worktreeId`. `resolveOperationPath` then selects `project.projectPath`, so this command checks against the primary checkout’s template rather than the invoking checkout’s guide. Different guide versions can produce incorrect results. Resolve the actual checkout or explicitly reject unregistered worktrees; add coverage beyond the registered-worktree case.
